authorization: User selected mask_only plus mask_rotation training and navigation comparison, limited to 20m initial radius before considering wider tests.
model_selection: Use each arm's validation-best epoch after both 150-epoch training arms finish and selection is frozen. Test both arms regardless of which has lower validation MSE. No navigation-based checkpoint selection.
success_definition: After the executed kinematic action endpoint reaches simulator-truth horizontal distance<=0.5m, terminate successfully; otherwise fail after50 actions. Segment crossing is diagnostic only.
supervision: Neural decisions receive raw RGB only; the exported graph owns resize and fixed circular mask, with no random inference rotation. Truth is used for evaluation and boundary/pose checks only, apart from separately labelled engineering oracle runs.
execution: Finish both training arms first. Use one Isaac application at a time. Run identical20m oracle and live model checks, then64 neural trials for mask_only and64 for mask_rotation. Record all frames and trajectories. No5/10/30/40m navigation or static held-out-test evaluation in this experiment.
limits: Same scene, one training seed and one run per matched starting pose; heading/nearby footprints are correlated. A positive success-rate difference is preliminary evidence at20m only, not a reliability guarantee or validation of hovering, autonomous home recognition or real flight dynamics.
